apple_errors.title: This request is forbidden for security reasons
apple_errors.detail: The API key in use does not allow this request

operations.note: User roles do not establish the independent role of a team API key.

conclusion.proven: Apple explicitly refuses the API key for POST /v1/appStoreVersions. App identity/read access and existing Build15 VALID are confirmed in the same authenticated attempt.
conclusion.key_role: Not exposed by the official API; do not infer the team key role from the returned ACCOUNT_HOLDER/ADMIN user roles.
conclusion.agreements: No agreement-specific error was returned. Account agreement state is not proven by this request.
conclusion.official_key_management: Apple documents creation through the authenticated Users and Access > Integrations > Team Keys UI. No API-key-management endpoint exists in the inspected official OpenAPI4.5.1.
conclusion.browser_evidence: No running Chromium/CDP process; provisioned browser roots contain no Cookies, Login Data or persisted session files. No browser/Apple account tool or managed Apple identity is connected.
conclusion.owner_connector: x6one repository writes are available, but no Secrets-management operation or Apple credential-management operation is exposed.
conclusion.owner_action_required: Replace the current GitHub Actions App Store Connect publishing credentials with a new Team API key assigned App Manager; keep automation least-privileged and never paste private key material into chat/repository/logs.
conclusion.issuer_note: Keep the existing ASC_ISSUER_ID if the replacement team key uses the same issuer.
conclusion.resume: Recheck only Store-version creation with the replacement authority. Prepare approved metadata and 12 genuine artwork images in both locales, attach existing accepted15, verify compliance/privacy, submit AppReview with AFTER_APPROVAL. Do not rerun native tests or upload/build15 again.

official_references.relevant_text: Team keys are generated by Account Holder or Admin; the role is selected under Access. Once generated, name/access level cannot be edited.
Required role: Account Holder, Admin, App Manager, or Marketing. Existing current version must be Ready for Distribution; actual current0.4.2 meets this prerequisite.
